meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have twenty minutes, so tell me who decided this and on what basis.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.

Turn the screen, Hale, I want to read it myself. I'm writing down 11:31, 11:52 and 11:58. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend, so where is he supposed to have done that, if not in this document?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.

A wrong quotation is a mistake a tired seventeen-year-old makes, Hale, not proof of anything. I'm writing down Act 3, Scene 2 and I'll search it myself tonight. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Then put it in writing today: the rewrite in your room Thursday at 8:15, nobody from his class there, and nothing on file. Owen does it to put this behind him, Hale, not because he did anything. And who else besides the vice-principal knows about this?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed that Owen will do a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15 with the vice-principal supervising, and that if it holds up the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I still require written confirmation that none of his classmates will be present and nothing will be placed on file, and I want to know who besides the vice-principal knows about this. I expect that in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to the supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15, and still wanting written confirmation that it stays private and off his record, plus an answer on who else knows.
What moved her: showing the version history with its exact times, then the line that is not in Hamlet, because both were specific, tied to the essay, and things she could check herself.
What cost ground: nothing; owning the early zero in one sentence and moving straight on bought you ground instead.
Try next time: when you offered the rewrite, you could have also promised the written terms by a set time and named who else knows, which would have closed her last open questions before the meeting ended.
